text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One particular day off, I'm passing by
the
academy entrance when...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-why are there so many couples
today?
A-and they're kissing? IN
PUBLIC?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-dammit! That motorcycle photo book
is gonna
sell out if I don't get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Y'know of any ways to avoid
the love
fest happenin' on the main
road?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The side roads! I totally forgot I could
use them
instead!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They're all twisty 'n' turny, but it's my
only way! I'll
just have to put the pedal
to the metal!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll catch ya later! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, I'm not afraid of
k-ki—things
like that! So don't get the
wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Run as fast as I can?! Oh, I get it! If I
zoom past,
then I won't have to see 'em
making out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'mma do just that! I've just gotta
run faster
than the speed of light!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aw, yeah! Nothin's gonna scare me now!
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...N-not that it was that big of a deal
anyway! I
just hate that wishy-washy
romance garbage!
Don't get the wrong
idea!
